items.briefing:
A new survey shows Australian executives are increasingly trusting AI tools in their organisations, even as audits continue to find errors in AI-generated outputs — a reminder that human oversight of AI decisions remains essential. Separately, a local tool called AIBUILD's AI Verifier has launched to help Australians identify scam messages, which is worth knowing about given the ongoing volume of SMS and email scams targeting Australians.

Security researcher Troy Hunt has also published a useful reminder about verifying data breach claims before acting on them — not every reported breach is real or as serious as claimed. **Practical tip:** If you receive an alert that your organisation's data has been breached, check with your IT or security team before taking any action or sharing the information further.
